attributes.board_name: New York State Board of Nursing (NYSED Office of the Professions)

topics.who: RN applicants (not LPNs) unless exempt; already covered by NY-registered RN programs completed after Sept 1, 1990

rules.notes: New York sets no general CE hours for RN/LPN registration renewal; the license is for life and the registration is renewed every 3 years. Mandatory trainings: infection control every 4 years, not tied to the 3-year registration (NYSED-approved course or approved exemption); one-time child abuse reporting.
